## Local checks and evidence

## CI evidence

<!-- Link the CI run for the latest commit and record its outcome/SHA.

## Teammate review

<!-- Request a teammate reviewer. Point them to behavior, tests, or clarity that
needs attention. Reviewers: leave specific comments and submit a review with an

Keep review permalinks for individual participation evidence. -->

- [ ] Latest CI run passes.
- [ ] A teammate reviewed meaningfully and approved the current change.
- [ ] Review concerns are addressed and conversations resolved.

See the [collaboration guidance](../docs/collaboration.md). Merge reviewed feature branches into `main`.
